skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: New Routes
skins.content:
LIMITED EDITION
Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals/New Routes. This simple style is customized for climbers. Its durable waterproof fabric possesses high thermal performance, making it possible to provide comprehensive care for adventurers.
skins.quote: A carefree journey starts from taking the next step.

skins.name: Speechless Sound
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Speechless Sound. Stage clothing picked by bassist Courier himself. People think of Kjerag's men as steadfast and untalkative, but Courier's ready with his bass to change their perception.
skins.quote: They say you can see another side to someone when they perform an instrument, but performing an instrument is itself an act too.
